title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Inlined stylesheets now rewrite relative `url()` and `@import` paths to absolute URLs against the stylesheet URL (`sheet.href`, or the link's absolute `href` when that is missing). `data:` URLs, other absolute URLs, and `url(#id)` stay as written. `<style>` elements and `style` attributes are unchanged. The match is a small scan, explained in ADR 0020.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.
